commit.message:
fix(b4-integrity): final evidence-integrity correction for supervised continuation, durable causal ledger, pages 5-level evidence, resurrection receipt authority, decay fail-closed, and control room parity

Defects 1+2: LIVE-mode continuation preflight fails closed on every unobserved
provider prerequisite (note 401/403/404/timeout, note-ID/author/issue-ownership
mismatch, provider target full-path mismatch, branch-HEAD inaccessibility or
drift); OFFLINE_REPLAY mode carries FIXTURE/RECORDED_INPUT provenance and never
presents itself as live authenticated continuation; new durable continuation
causal ledger (atomic fsynced writes, cross-process lock, per-entry integrity
digests, FIRST_STARTED != FIRST_COMPLETED, PARTIAL/FAILED never
COMPLETED_IDEMPOTENT, corruption/recovery/concurrency fail-closed); verdict
derived from the executed review, never hard-coded BLOCKED.

Defect 3: Level 1 requires the exact Pages job with commit binding (pipeline
SUCCESS never inferred); Level 2 uses only the documented Pages deployments
API (honestly NOT_OBSERVED); Level 4 probes only the pinned target URLs
(generic *.gitlab.io refused); Level 5 separates served presence from
source-corroborated publication; marker/URL override refused; fixed latent
positional-timeout bug in the default served-URL getter.

Defect 4: resurrection receipt authority reuses the established
capsule/ledger/absence contracts; forged schema-correct receipts fail; current
observation must bind to the same exact target and URL.

Defect 5: empty evidence bundles never evaluate to authoritative FRESH;
provider errors fail closed with malformed status representations; TTL bounds
validated in the bundle path.

Defect 6: evidence records regenerated live (read-only, \.00); Control Room
displays FRESH WHEN RECORDED with no success-looking fallbacks; data.js
regenerated; verified in a real browser (5 tabs, zero console errors, zero
network fetches).

Defect 7: README, master execution plan (baseline rows + WORK-B4-27), evidence
matrix and handoff updated atomically; IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED until
independent QA.

Suite: 505 passed (network-free adversarial paths via injected transports),
ruff clean, 40/40 network-free safety assertions.
